lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteers. The dataset represents approximately 13.4 million buildings with an average data age of 1 year 10 months, with 9% of buildings added or updated in the last 6 months. Data are provided in multiple GIS-compatible formats (GeoJSON, KML, GeoPackage) for spatial analysis and risk assessment applications.
